data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Cassandra, meaning 'she who carries a prophecy.' In Greek mythology, Cassandra was a Trojan princess with the gift of prophecy, but she was unable to persuade others to believe her predictions. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'kassandra,' meaning 'to call forth a prophecy,' or 'to foretell.'
